definitions.explanation: Describes food that is rich in fat, oil, or strong flavors. Often refers to dishes with thick, creamy, or oily textures and bold tastes.
Describes something applied in a thick, heavy layer, such as makeup or paint.

examples.japanese: こってりしたラーメンが{好|す}きだ。
{今日|きょう}はこってりした{料理|りょうり}は{避|さ}けたい。
examples.english: Today I want to avoid heavy, rich food.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はこってり{化粧|けしょう}をしている。

notes:
USAGE:
As adverb: こってり + verb
・こってり{味付|あじつ}けする (to season richly)
・こってり{塗|ぬ}る (to apply thickly)

As na-adjective: こってりした/こってりの + noun
・こってりした{味|あじ} (rich flavor)
・こってりのスープ (thick, rich soup)

Sense 1 (food):
Describes ramen, stews, fried foods, and dishes with rich broths or fatty ingredients. Commonly used when ordering ramen:
・こってり{系|けい} (rich/heavy style)
・あっさり{系|けい} (light style)

Sense 2 (applied heavily):
・こってり{化粧|けしょう} (heavy makeup)
・こってりペンキを{塗|ぬ}る (to paint thickly)

ANTONYM:
・あっさり (light, plain, refreshing) - opposite in taste/texture
